Celesteville archives

The faces of the kingdom

Portraits and full-body sprites for all 33 members of the family, council and story archive.

A crossover of the books, television series, Badou generation and movie history. Clothing and equipment are game interpretations. Children remain civilian support; historical figures remain tributes. These are single-pose sprites, not animated movement sheets.

New artwork generated for this fan game using Internet visual references. Some lesser-documented appearances are original interpretations, not verified canonical costumes.
